versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core logic or functionality.
- Documentation and workflow instructions remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the 子网计算服务 (Subnet Calculator) skill.
- Provides IPv4 subnet planning tools: subnet size calculation, wildcard mask generation, gateway selection, and host validation.
- Strictly requires an API key for all operations; prompts user for key if missing.
- Implements a clear workflow for tool selection and parameter extraction based on user intent.
- Offers functions for subnet calculations, OSPF wildcard mask generation, IP/subnet validation, network info extraction, and Nth usable IP lookup.
